STEP 1 - Vessel type: The vessel has a curved inner wall visible on the left and a shadow inside, and the food sits well below the rim on the right side. It is a shallow bowl (oval/wide serving bowl).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: a serving or salad bowl is 20-25 cm; this one is a medium-large oval bowl, so about 22 cm.
b) Reference: the broccoli florets are about 4 cm. The bowl spans roughly 5-6 florets across the width of the bowl's visible rim, giving about 20-24 cm. The bowl's visible rim runs from about x=210 to x=640 px, roughly 430 px; a broccoli floret is about 60-70 px, so about 6.5 florets, giving ~26 cm. Reconciling the two, width ≈ 23 cm.

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Greens (arugula/leafy salad, right side): covers roughly 30% of the bowl, loose leaves 3-4 cm deep. Raw leafy greens, bulk density 0.15. Footprint: the bowl area is about 0.6 of 23² ≈ 415 cm²... using a 30% share of the vessel area gives ~125 cm² x 3 cm = 375 ml x 0.15 = ~56 g.
- Broccoli florets (about 8 florets, partly hidden): chopped vegetables 0.6, footprint ~10% (≈40 cm²) x 2.5 cm = 100 ml x 0.6 = ~60 g.
- Carrot slices (orange, about 12 pieces, chopped vegetable): ~10% (≈40 cm²) x 1.5 cm = 60 ml x 0.6 = ~36 g.
- Yellow squash slices: ~7% (≈30 cm²) x 1 cm = 30 ml x 0.6 = ~18 g.
- Grain mix (brown rice/farro with vegetables and some meat, bottom centre): mound, 15% (≈60 cm²) x 2.5 cm average (about half of 4-5 cm peak) = 150 ml x 0.8 = ~120 g.
- Cooked meat/tofu pieces mixed in the grain: estimated ~15 g, included as a share of the grain layer; listed separately.

Hidden food: the grain mix base extends under the greens and broccoli; the estimates above already include the visible layers, with a modest hidden share added to the grain.

Totals: greens 56 g, broccoli 60 g, carrot 36 g, squash 18 g, grain 120 g, meat 15 g, about 305 g total.

Energy (kcal per 100 g, as served):
- Mixed salad greens: 25
- Broccoli, cooked: 35
- Carrot, cooked: 35
- Yellow squash, cooked: 20
- Cooked grain mix (rice/farro): 130
- Cooked meat: 170

Energy: greens 14 + broccoli 21 + carrot 13 + squash 4 + grain 156 + meat 26 = about 234 kcal.
